snippet.title: Croakspire - Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744870/Croakspire/

Croakspire is a 2D Metroidvania action-adventure game where you play as a frog who attacks enemies with his tongue! Travel through a vast fortress full of unique enemies using fast and snappy movement options, and gain a vast array of different powers to use in this retro-inspired platformer! 

Join the Discord! - https://discord.gg/F9RnFgH8e2
Follow for updates and teasers! - https://x.com/LotusWaveArcade
